title: Evacuation Guidance
text: “Where are we…!?”

My father is surveying the area. As expected—or however you want to put it—a wave has struck near Riyute Village, which is close to the town of Melromarc. Ren, Itsuki, and their companions are running toward the crack in the wave.

It brings back memories. Back when I first encountered a wave, I didn’t even glance to the side; I ignored my father’s voice and let my heart race with excitement for the battle. Part of it was also that I wanted to experience just how much training I’d put in. The level I’d raised in such a short time… with that strength, I could easily overcome the first wave. That was all I could think about.
“Huh? Hey! …It turned out just like Motoyasu-kun said. Ren and Itsuki didn’t even think about guiding people to safety—they just charged straight toward it.”

It’s infuriating how he’s casting that lighting Magic just to show off. I could certainly knock some air out of his ego, but drawing too much attention to myself could be a problem, so I’ll just keep a low profile as Father instructed.

“Alright, let’s guide the villagers to safety as planned. Keel, Sakura, Yuki, Kou, and Elena—you guys take care of that. Me and Motoyasu will draw the monsters coming toward the village, so please do your best to minimize any damage.”
“Got it, big bro! Once everyone’s evacuated… we’ll fight the boss, right?”
Keel’s barking “Woof woof!” with excitement.
“This time, I’ll definitely protect everyone from the waves! Woof woof!”
“Keel, you’re getting too excited. Sakura, please keep a close eye on him so he doesn’t get hurt.”
“Got it!”
“Yuki-chan and Kou, you two need to help everyone, too.”
“I know.”
“Are the monsters from the waves tasty? I want Iwatani to cook them for me when this is over.”
“Yeah, yeah… Wait, are the monsters coming out of the waves dimensional ghouls? Zombies and… locusts? Maybe bees too? I don’t think any of them are suitable for eating, though…”
My father is muttering about making tsukudani or something. The corpse-eaters look pretty rotten, so even Kou wouldn’t think of eating them. The boss, the chimera, might just be edible, though.
“Oink… oink oink.”
“Yeah. Elena, do your best, but don’t overdo it. You know when to back off, so if Keel or Sakura look like they’re getting in too deep, please stop them.”
“Oink.”
“Alright, let’s hurry over there.”

We nodded at Father’s words and headed toward Riyute Village. Thanks to Filolial-sama and the others, we were able to stand in the way before the monsters could invade Riyute Village. The villagers probably knew a wave was coming, but their expressions suggest they never dreamed it would happen this close. The adventurers seemed to be preparing for battle against the monsters approaching the village, but their movements appeared sluggish.

Recalling our previous run when we went with Father toward Siltvelt, it’s safe to say this village would be destroyed if Father didn’t protect it. In the first world, I recall that although there were scars, they were repaired after a while. If that’s the case, then for the sake of the future, I must protect them.
“Ah! Is that the Filolial Ranch!?”

Come to think of it, there was a ranch in Riyute Village that raised monsters. If things continue like this, Filolial-sama will be swept away by the wave and die. Above all, Filolial-sama are bound to be prioritized lower than humans.
“Wooooooooooooooah!”
“Hey! Motoyasu, where are you going!?”
I sprinted desperately toward the ranch, smashed through the fence, and let Filolial-sama escape. Then, after confirming that everyone had made it to safety, I returned…
“Evacuate quickly!”
My Father was shouting this to the villagers.
“Ah, you’re finally back. Where were you?”
“I was saving the Filolial-sama.”
“Ah… I see. I understand how you feel, but Motoyasu, you’re the strongest among us, so you need to think things through a little more.”
“I understand.”
“Hmm… I wonder if he really gets it…”

And so, Father began leading the villagers to safety. At first, the villagers looked displeased at my Father—the Shield Hero—but upon seeing the monsters swarming out of the crack, their faces turned pale, and they hurriedly prepared to evacuate. Following my Father’s instructions, Keel and Sakura-chan protected the villagers while defeating the monsters attacking the village.
“Hurry up and get out of here! Otherwise, everyone’s going to die! Sakura-chan! A huge monster’s heading that way!”

While they were guiding the villagers, a large ghoul reached the village. If they were fighting at full strength, they could wipe out a wave like this instantly, but that’s not an option. They’re holding back somewhat, as Father instructed.
“Leave it to me!”
Sakura-chan transformed into the Filolial Queen and, spinning with the swords held in both her wings, sliced the large ghoul into three pieces.
“Amazing…”

An adventurer guarding the village lets out a gasp. Are the reinforcements from the castle still on their way? This wave is just too numerous. If we hold back too much, the casualties will be far too high.

Even as I’m considering whether to wipe them out with Magic, locusts, bees, and ghouls keep pouring in one after another. What are Ren and Itsuki doing? Well, neither of them is particularly strong, so I suppose it can’t be helped.
“Motoyasu! Do your best to keep them from getting close!”
“I know! Here comes the Air Strike Javelin!”
I hurl the spear with all my might, scattering the swarming monsters.
“Ooogggg!”
At the pig’s scream, my Father turns around and holds his hand out toward the pig, which is about to be attacked by the monsters.
“Shield Prison!”
With a thud, he summoned a shield cage and protected the pig.
“Evacuate quickly! Those who can fight, protect the non-combatants!”
The villagers reluctantly nodded at Father’s orders. And… not only the villagers, but the adventurers as well evacuated together.
“Huh? Wait a minute…”
“I suppose everyone’s just afraid of dying, huh?”
“Hmm… Well, I guess it can’t be helped…”
“It’s easier for us to handle this on our own than with a bunch of weaklings and pigs swarming around.”

He says this dismissively while fighting. We don’t need to show any mercy to a bunch of people who abandoned us—the ones who saved their lives—and ran away. At the same time, my Father, who’s being swarmed by monsters, deploys his Shooting Star Shield and knocks them back. My father’s barrier sure comes in handy.
Just as I was thinking that, a rain of fire rained down on me and my father. I’m naturally strong, so it didn’t even scratch me. My father doesn’t seem to have any visible injuries either.
“Hey! We’ve got allies here!”

My father, whose anger was plain to see, glared at the knights who had rushed in—the very ones who’d just cast that Magic spell. Seriously. Looking over, I saw the entire knightly order chanting Magic spells in unison, pouring down a rain of fire. You could tell from their expressions that, if possible, they’d love to see my father dead.

My father’s Shooting Star Shield maintains its shape as if the rain of fire unleashed by the Knights of the Order had no effect whatsoever… but isn’t it about time we taught those guys a lesson in knowing their place? Not just me, but Keel, Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, and Kou are all glaring at the Captain of the Knight Order.
“Hmph, the Shield Hero and the Spear Hero, huh… they’re a tough bunch.”
What an arrogant attitude. Should I unleash a storm of flames like in the previous cycle and make them vanish? Just as I’m about to cast a spell, my Father grabs my hand.

Even though he’s my Father, I really want him to let me cast it. I never expected him to do something like this. Maybe… my Father from the future also experienced this “baptism of Magic” in the same way.
I find this even more unforgivable. But since my Father is stopping me, I’ll hold back—just for now. My blood is boiling with rage, Motoyasu.
“What the hell are you doing all of a sudden! We’re trying our best to get everyone to safety here!”
I can hear Keel’s shout. Growling, Keel is pointing his dagger at the Captain of the Knight Order.
“A companion of the Shield Hero… So you really are bringing a tainted Demi-Human along with you—that really shows what you’re made of!”
“What do you mean, ‘tainted’! We’re fighting to protect everyone! If you attack us, we won’t hold back!”
My father, using his cloak to fan away the raging flames, approached Keel and said,
“Keel, calm down—and you too, Sakura.”
In a swift, fluid motion, Sakura transformed into an angel, moved behind the Captain of the Knight Order, and pressed her sword against the nape of his neck.
“Huh!? You!”
“Depending on your answer, I might put some force into the side of the blade and slice you open. I’ll make sure to cleanly sever your head for you—”
She says this with an innocent expression, but she’s radiating a powerful killing intent. That’s Sakura for you. I hope this helps her understand her own position, even just a little.
“To point a sword at me—you must really want to die!”
He doesn’t get it at all. At this point, I feel like it might be okay to blow his head off. Just as I’m thinking that, my Father glares coldly at the enraged Captain of the Knight Order.
“…The enemy is the monster crawling out of the waves. Don’t get it twisted!”
At my Father’s rebuke, the knights all look away. Well, their true objective isn’t to calm the waves—it’s Father’s life, after all.
“What’s a criminal ‘hero’ like you babbling about?”
“In that case… I’m moving on, so you lot can handle the rest on your own.”

Father is pointing at the monsters涌ing out of the waves. Disappearing his Shooting Star Shield, he reaches out toward the chest of the Captain of the Knight Order, who is being threatened with a sword by Sakura-chan.
“Hmph! Let go, you insolent fool!”

“Oh, that’s right—I am insolent. You lot haven’t done anything to deserve politeness. Isn’t it rude, to begin with, to cast Magic at us—the ones who were guiding people to safety and holding off the monsters? Well then… I’ll just drag you along to fight alongside me. What’s the big deal? If you can last five minutes in an endurance battle with me, I won’t make you apologize. Come on, let’s do this.”
Ranting and raving, my Father tries to drag the Captain of the Knight Order toward the horde of monsters.

“Ah, getting hit by Magic didn’t even make me flinch, so I’m not that angry. But if you’re going to act all high and mighty, thinking I can only protect you, then I’ll make you… experience firsthand just how hard that protection really is.”

Oh… how wonderful. That expression, every bit as intense as my future Father’s… I was truly moved. He’s usually very gentle, but every now and then, he shows glimpses of his true toughness. Ah, as expected of the future leader of the Four Holy Heroes! He’s my Father, after all!
“L-let go! Stop it!”
My Father suddenly let go and glared at the Captain of the Knight Order.
“For someone who’s just the Shield Hero~~~~…”
“Huh!? Still talking trash? If you don’t cut it out, I’ll feed you to the wave monsters!”

Whether Father’s threat worked or not, not only the Captain of the Knight Order but even some of the other knights started to flinch in fear. After all, we’re drawing the massive swarm of monsters toward us all at once. In fact, with me, Keel, Yuki-chan, Kou, and even the Lazy Pig joining in, we’re barely managing to hold back the monsters trying to invade the village.
“I’m telling you not to confuse friend from foe! Got it?!”

Nodding vigorously at Father’s voice, the Captain of the Knight Order fled in a most undignified manner. Haha, that was beyond pathetic. Well, I’ll deal with this offense later… maybe I’ll assassinate him on a moonless night?
After that, thanks to the reinforcements arriving, the evacuation was complete, and we had our hands free.
“Motoyasu! We’ve got things pretty much under control over here, so could you handle the Wave Fissure and the boss?”
“Understood. Alright then, Yuki-chan, Kou, let’s go!”
“Got it!”
“Fresh bugs are so yummy!”
“Kou, try not to eat too many!”
My Father scolded Kou, who was munching away on bugs. I climbed onto Yuki-chan’s back and headed toward Ren and Itsuki, who were still dawdling around in battle.
